ACTION=A3
Rationale: The ego vehicle is traveling at 50 kph and approaches a merge vehicle cutting in from the left ($y=3.5$ moving towards $y=0.0$) at $x=27.2\text{ m}$, as well as a crossing cyclist further ahead at $x=34.2\text{ m}$. To maintain safe following and interaction distances with both dynamic agents merging and crossing the roadway, applying a moderate deceleration (braking) is necessary.
